_meta.description: Mi Speaks empowers communication through innovative voice technology, making it easier than ever to express yourself.
_title: Mi Speaks - Voice Communication Made Easy
a-standalone-watch-reader.3aaf1c: A standalone watch reader with background audio — through the speaker or your Bluetooth headphones — that highlights each word as it's spoken. Progress syncs both ways, so your iPhone and watch resume each other seamlessly.
absolutely-mi-speaks-works.647c20: Absolutely! Mi Speaks works with any voice installed on your device. You can download additional voices in your device's Settings app to access different languages, accents, and voice styles.
affordable-private-text-to.36ac6d: Affordable, private text-to-speech that runs entirely on your device
blaine-miller-all-rights.b327c2: © Blaine Miller. All rights reserved.
built-in-helpful-tips.a104d6: Built-in helpful tips guide you through features and help you get the most out of Mi Speaks.
can-i-import-text.83b6aa: Can I import text from images?
complete-privacy-all-processing.b37baf: Complete privacy—all processing happens on your device. No data is collected, tracked, or sent anywhere. Affordable and privacy-focused.
continue-listening-while-using.8df13d: Continue listening while using other apps or when your screen is locked. Pause and resume anytime.
does-it-highlight-text.8717e1: Does it highlight text as it reads?
follow-along-with-highlighted.2309b6: Follow along with highlighted text as Mi Speaks reads, making it easier to read and comprehend content.
follow-along-with-highlighted.a6cb7e: Follow along with highlighted text as Mi Speaks reads, making it easier to understand and retain information.
get-unlimited-text-input.9c66ff: Get unlimited text input, cross-device speech sync via iCloud Drive, saved speeches with playback positions, and export your audio to files for use in other projects.
home-screen-and-lock.e55fb0: Home screen and lock screen widgets show your last speech and how far you got, and tap straight back into playback. Surfaces in the Smart Stack while a speech is partially read.
import-text-from-other.cfc3a5: Import text from other apps, extract text from images, and even read PDF files with powerful text recognition.
import-text-pdfs-or.69f1ec: Import text, PDFs, or photos (with text recognition) into saved speeches; play, pause, and resume from automations; switch voices and playback speed; render any text to an audio file fully offline; and export a sentence range as audio — every action chainable in Shortcuts.
listen-using-any-voice.a73812: Listen using any voice available on your device. Download even more voices in the Settings App for endless customization.
mi-speaks-can-read.079199: Mi Speaks can read any written content including text you type, content from other apps, text extracted from images, and PDF files. Perfect for articles, documents, emails, books, and more.
mi-speaks-lets-you.a4a62d: Mi Speaks lets you listen and read along to various media on your devices. Transform any text into natural-sounding speech with powerful features and customization.
perfect-for-reading-articles.f2b09e: Perfect for reading articles while commuting, listening to documents while working out, or helping with accessibility needs.
premium-unlocks-cross-device.f83740: Premium unlocks cross-device speech sync via iCloud Drive, unlimited text input, saved speeches with playback positions, the ability to share spoken text as audio files, and increased playback speed with Turbo mode. Available as monthly, yearly subscriptions, or a lifetime purchase.
ready-for-ios-27.75e4d6: ✓ Ready for iOS 27 / iPadOS 27 / watchOS 27
saved-speeches-are-indexed.0c5e42: Saved speeches are indexed by their content, so a phrase you remember finds the speech. Tap a result and you land right back in it, ready to play.
spotlight-search-shortcuts-audio.3e80f9: Spotlight search, Shortcuts audio rendering, a Resume Reading widget, and an Apple Watch reader
transform-any-written-content.0d5682: Transform any written content into natural-sounding speech. Import text from images, PDFs, web pages, or type directly into the app. Mi Speaks makes all your content accessible through audio.
turbo-mode-lets-you.9890fc: Turbo mode lets you increase playback speed for faster listening. All at an affordable price that makes premium text-to-speech accessible to everyone.
what-can-i-listen.482923: What can I listen to with Mi Speaks?
works-completely-offline-once.fe7460: Works completely offline once you've downloaded your preferred voices. Listen to your content anywhere without worrying about internet connectivity or data usage.
yes-mi-speaks-highlights.298462: Yes! Mi Speaks highlights and follows spoken words as it reads, making it easier to follow along, improve comprehension, and learn new content.
yes-mi-speaks-includes.7a0f2a: Yes! Mi Speaks includes powerful text recognition that can extract text from images and PDF files, making it easy to listen to content from photos, documents, and scanned materials.
yes-mi-speaks-is.f1ab38: Yes! Mi Speaks is fully offline compatible. Once you've downloaded voices through your device Settings, you can listen to content anywhere without needing an internet connection.
